requiredFeatures: An open gold-edged book is the first focal point and remains immediately readable at phone scale.
A seven-cell honeycomb wisdom cluster rises directly above or behind the book as the second focal point.
The book has two distinct cream page blocks, a dark central spine, visible gold page lines, and a physically seated reading dais.
The honeycomb cluster has thick gold frames, dark occupied sockets, one warm central cell, and a real structural support into the archive tower.
A broad closed reading hall, clear front entry, mirrored side reading pods, and solid rear closure make the icon into usable architecture.
Side and rear elevations continue shelf windows, bands, and a subordinate rear book/hex mark without exposing a blank slab.
The upper silhouette remains scholarly and distinct from the Palace keep, Nursery egg, and Pollinator/Trials radial structures.
Honey details are selective and do not turn the book into a purple roof or generic awning.
strictRejects: purple roof or ordinary gabled-roof reading
single generic hex halo instead of seven-cell wisdom cluster
bee mascot replacing the book identity
book or cluster obscuring the entry
more than one bounded correction in this construction family

capture.blockoutGate: All structural categories at least 0.75 with no strict reject.
capture.finalGate: All required categories at least 0.85 with no strict reject.
